label: WRONG
reason: The injectable repository classes (MaintenanceHealthRepository, AlbumRepository, TagRepository) are named *Repository, and no lint rule enforces naming, but the one outlier, BaseSync in sync.repository.ts:101, is an exported base class for the AlbumSync/AssetSync helper subclasses next to SyncRepository, and MyConsoleLogger in logging.repository.ts is a ConsoleLogger subclass. Both are another kind of class, so 0 of 2 counted outliers are mistakes (R1/R2). An agent adding a base or helper class to a repository file would be told to rename it, and access.repository.ts and sync.repository.ts already hold many such helper classes (not exported).
